title: SBC Medical Group discloses theft of data on about 1.6 million customers in Japan
date_note: Unauthorized access and discovery were on November 16; the company announced it on November 18.
summary: SBC Medical Group (Nasdaq: SBC) said an unauthorized third party accessed and extracted customer information from a website database run by its Japanese subsidiary on November 16. Based on current information, 1,624,000 people had basic personal data affected, plus about 20,000 employee account records. A second incident hit clinic accounts on the Tribeau booking platform. The intrusion method is under investigation.
plain: A clinic management group says an outsider copied personal details of about 1.6 million customers in Japan, including names, contacts and passwords. How they got in is still unknown.
exec: Large health-sector breach with passwords exposed and a third-party booking platform also compromised; shows supplier and customer-database risk.
action: If you are an SBC clinic customer or employee, change reused passwords and watch for phishing; organisations using Tribeau should reset clinic admin credentials.
impact: Basic personal data of 1,624,000 people (based on current information); about 20,000 employee account records; Tribeau: 12,641 people's reservation data.

sources.name: SBC Medical Group press release (SEC Exhibit 99.1)

validation.note: The company's own press release filed with the SEC (Nov 18) and BleepingComputer's report agree on figures and dates. No attacker named; intrusion method under investigation.
